name: Blank environment and algorithm assignment
description: The application begins with no sandboxes or algorithmic pattern and allows assigning a generating algorithm to an empty environment.
steps: Open the node editor and verify No algorithms exist yet.
Verify node says No algorithm and No content
Press Step +1 and examine tick count and changing mean pattern
expected: No pattern is prefilled. An empty ENV 1 is created, then Diffusion generates a visible pattern only after it is selected. Tick advances to 0001.

name: Connect two pattern nodes and measure algorithm coupling
description: Pattern output A feeds and modifies the pre-existing algorithm of B.
steps: Locate ENV 2 in Observe the experiment and examine impact
Confirm a relationship appears in the Connections panel
expected: ENV 1 Diffusion output is connected to ENV 2 Cellular activation, and impact in ENV 2 becomes nonzero after one tick.

name: Remove and inhibit a relationship without removing algorithms
description: The connection can be changed or deleted while preserving both algorithms.
steps: In Connections select Inhibit (−) and press Step +1
expected: The relationship can inhibit the destination. When disabled, ENV 2 input impact reads 0.0000. Removing it leaves both environments and their algorithms present.

name: Move and remove graph nodes on mobile
description: Node positions can be rearranged and deleting an environment cleans up relationships.
steps: Drag ENV 2 by its header within the graph
expected: ENV 2 is repositioned, ENV 1 is deleted, the connection disappears and ENV 2 retains its Cellular activation algorithm.

name: Export and restore the network
description: A graph can be saved, cleared, and restored with algorithm states and relationship settings.
steps: Click Export JSON and save the file
Click Import JSON and select the file previously exported
expected: Two environments and one relationship reappear after import, each preserving its assigned algorithm and saved state.
